name: Abbots Bromley

attributes.attribute: keeps power only inside the town
holds a horn hunt each September

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Abbots Bromley is a town in England on land once held by the Curnovii, the horned tribe. A trace of the old horned god Cernunnos may remain in the town. Early each September, men wearing antlers are chased through the streets. After the chase they dance the Horn Dance. The dance brings luck but loses power if done outside the town. Old Celtic belief often hides in folk custom, so this pageant may be ancient.

okr.objective: Describe the Abbots Bromley horned dance site.
key_results: Notes the dance works only in town.
